standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness of a resolution in dimension one and of the normalization for alterations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Varieties, the lemma that a modification of a one dimensional scheme is finite, and Same chapter, the lemma deducing finiteness of the normalization from a regular alteration
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the finiteness of the resolution used to build the ascending chain and the implication from a regular alteration to finiteness of the normalization.

standard_prerequisites.name: Ascending chain condition for coherent submodules of a coherent module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology of Schemes, the lemma that a coherent sheaf on a Noetherian scheme has the ascending chain condition on coherent submodules
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the stabilization of the ascending chain of pushforwards of structure sheaves.

standard_prerequisites.name: Universal property of blowing up
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, the lemma giving the universal property of the blowing up of an ideal, applied to the pullback of a maximal ideal which is invertible on the resolution
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the factorization of the resolution through each blowup in the constructed sequence.

core_obligations: Dispose of the easy implications (proof lines 4261-4270): the implications from the sequence of blowups to a resolution and from a resolution to an alteration are immediate; a regular alteration gives finiteness of the normalization by the earlier lemma, while a normal one dimensional scheme is regular, so the remaining task is to deduce the existence of the sequence of blowups from the other conditions.

Build an ascending chain of pushforwards (proof lines 4272-4290): starting from a resolution, which is finite in dimension one, construct factorizations of it through blowups of closed points as long as the intermediate scheme is not regular; each step is again finite and gives an ascending chain of coherent submodules of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the resolution.

Conclude by stabilization (proof lines 4290-4298): since the base is Noetherian the chain stabilizes, which forces an intermediate scheme in the factorization to be regular, yielding the required finite sequence of blowups; the factorization at each step exists because the pullback of the maximal ideal of the point being blown up becomes invertible on the regular curve and the universal property of blowing up applies, and the step is not an isomorphism because that maximal ideal is not invertible before the blowup.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the implication from the other conditions to the existence of a sequence of blowups.
Factor a finite resolution through blowups of closed points as long as the intermediate scheme is singular, keeping survey of the ascending chain of pushforwards.
Use the ascending chain condition to force an intermediate regular scheme and conclude the sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of four conditions for a one dimensional integral Noetherian scheme: the existence of a regular alteration, the existence of a resolution of singularities, the existence of a finite sequence of blowups in closed points ending in a regular scheme, and finiteness of the normalization (statement lines 4247-4259). The proof (proof lines 4261-4304) disposes of the easy implications, factors a finite resolution through blowups of closed points while recording an ascending chain of coherent submodules, and concludes by the ascending chain condition. H3: an original termination argument via an ascending chain, written out in full.
